label: Cluster reassessment of immaterial-intellect and director-recognition premises (#1751)
summary: Issue #1751 model-trial slice 3/3: reassessment of the nine open GOD_4-route premises that the currentness view lists as legacy_only and whose attempts cite docs/immaterial-intellect-reception.md. All nine were verified legacy_only on main 46d0d7d0; none overlaps the modal-spine (dd24400b) or eternity-dependence (447838c8) slices. Seven are governed by that note: the grade route 0bdb0436, 5854ef2b, 44000fce (to 180f5ad2 through 5ae23956); the knowing-director premise 564ce19b; and the reduction inputs 251bbfdd, e8ffcdad, acc06edc (to 11914511 through 4f6713a1 or 3af0a49e). Two, 3c468121 and 30a8373c, are members only through an incidental path citation in c80cb2d6; they are assessed from docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md, docs/being-not-a-genus.md and their own attempts. Reread the whole note, the three citing attempts, the further attempts on these targets, the teleonomy notes and the #1750 same-witness assessment (a1b799fe); every target got dossier and brief retrieval, and the main results got context retrieval. The section fixes meanings (HAS_INTELLECT_1 capacity-level and distinct from the Fifth-Way HasCognition and Intelligent parameters; the root consumers instantiate Intelligent alone by HasIntellect, and HasCognition stays a separate parameter; causing a cognitive perfection, possessing it formally or eminently, and cognizing kept apart), states the warrant, direct option and shared dependencies of each premise, and classifies fourteen recorded objection or rival records under the 2026-11-12 standard with one stated scope criterion. Kept: 1 (teleonomy, as an undercutter of the warrant of 564ce19b within its mechanisms' demonstrated domains, not of its content). Restated: 13, among them the noncognitive immaterial-nature rival against 0bdb0436 and the intrinsic-directive-nature rival against acc06edc, whose mechanisms have no independent justification at the scope of their targets; the abstract-object condition, conditional on a domain choice no record makes; and all countermodels and omission controls as facts about interpretations. No strength grade is assigned, following the earlier refusal of a confidence ranking. The judgment is unchanged from the 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-17 sections and #1750: intellect at the first source is positively motivated from two families sharing no intellect-specific inputs (on one witness they share the ten structural inputs, the supplied root 7abdee27 and the will principle 090be689, and are not independent corroborations), and neither family's intellect-specific step (the exhaustive-explanation step behind 0bdb0436; first-source recognition acc06edc, which the local route's reduction clause also carries, with the open universal step of e8ffcdad or 251bbfdd for the governor route) has independent warrant on file. New, revising nothing: first standing statements for 3c468121 and 30a8373c; a first consolidated standing statement for 44000fce that keeps its recorded structural-to-grade burden open and moves none of it to 0bdb0436; a claim/type observation that acc06edc's consequent is two predicates of the director and does not mention the end; the scope criterion and row 5's undercutting classification. No theorem, Challenge, claim, definition, sense, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Retained from 1d6cfc76: recognition acc06edc remains open; the inspected profiles supply no independent warrant that nonreceived real final ordering must be possession of the same end as known and not intrinsic directive nature. Reopen on independently supported intellectual presence applying without passive acquisition to the same first source and end, a warranted pure-perfection criterion discriminating formal intellectual possession from eminent production, or a substantive rival mechanism satisfying those same first-source premises. Also retained: the exhaustive-explanation step behind 0bdb0436 (2026-11-11); the universal steps of 251bbfdd and e8ffcdad; the necessity-cause dictionary bridge for 3c468121 (4381d190, c28c61d8); the uncaused-primary applicability and identity gaps for 30a8373c (762d5fac). Ground existence, global unmovedness, termination, governor and naming provenance and the HasIntellect application remain separate obligations. Next test: Scope audit of the consumers of 180f5ad2: for each, decide whether it applies the immateriality reading only at an actual concrete bearer (the #1750 tuple 017befa2 applies it at the selected actual root). If so, register guarded weak versions of 44000fce and 0bdb0436 with strengthens relations and let those consumers use them, so the abstract-object condition no longer reaches the routes; if some consumer needs the unguarded scope, record the domain of Being as a meaning decision. A concrete-bearer guard settles only the abstract-object condition; the 2026-11-09 burden of a concrete but nonliving immaterial bearer remains. Apply the same audit to 3c468121's consumers against the direct interface cb1cdea9. For first-source recognition acc06edc the 2026-11-17 finding stands: no further distinct test in the inspected profiles; the allocation recommendation to the q.11 common-nature node 0730d46f is retained.

current_assessment.scope: Immaterial-intellect reception legacy cluster: the nine open GOD_4-route premises whose legacy attempts cite docs/immaterial-intellect-reception.md. Grades of immateriality (0bdb0436, 5854ef2b, 44000fce), the knowing-director premise (564ce19b), the reduction to an unmoved knowing director (251bbfdd, e8ffcdad, acc06edc), and two members governed by other notes (3c468121, 30a8373c). The #1750 same-witness assessment (a1b799fe) keeps its own scope and is reused, not replaced.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (HAS_INTELLECT_1 capacity-level; the Fifth-Way HasCognition and Intelligent as separate primitives, of which the root consumers instantiate Intelligent alone by HasIntellect; causing a cognitive perfection, possessing it formally or eminently, and actually cognizing kept apart; unmoved as moved in no respect) intellect at the first source is positively motivated from two families that share no intellect-specific inputs: the q.14 grades of immateriality and the Fifth-Way director with its reduction. On one witness they share the ten structural inputs, the supplied root 7abdee27 and the will principle 090be689, so they are not independent corroborations (#1750); the Rochette episode serves both 5854ef2b and e8ffcdad. Neither family's intellect-specific step has independent warrant on file: the exhaustive-explanation step behind 0bdb0436 (with structural-to-grade applicability 44000fce also open), and first-source recognition acc06edc, which the local route carries in the reduction clause of 65c409cc (#1750); the governor route also needs the open universal step of e8ffcdad or 251bbfdd. This is the 2026-11-11, 2026-11-17 and #1750 judgment, unchanged; no strength grade is assigned and no ranking between the complete accounts is made. 5854ef2b keeps the direct prima facie warrant recorded for intellectual activity, with no objection on file. 564ce19b and 30a8373c are source-stated. 0bdb0436, 251bbfdd and acc06edc are source-supported with recorded gaps and keep their direct options. e8ffcdad has local instrumental warrant and an open universal step, and is the version the reduction needs. 44000fce keeps its recorded standing in a first consolidated statement: an open bare analyst premise whose structural-to-grade applicability (the DEF-ALTOGETHER-IMMATERIAL reading choice and the absent concreteness or life condition) stays open. 3c468121 and 30a8373c receive first standing statements, ungraded: an open dictionary bridge, and a source-stated premise with an open identity gap for its supplied primary. Kept objections: 1 (teleonomy undercuts the warrant of 564ce19b in its mechanisms' demonstrated domains and does not deny a director). Restated: 13. The noncognitive immaterial-nature and intrinsic-directive-nature rivals are named hypotheses whose mechanisms are justified only outside the scope of their targets; they are not evidence against 0bdb0436 or acc06edc (no substantive objection to their truth is identified), that does not supply the missing positive warrant, and the intrinsic-nature rival remains a candidate primitive stopping point parallel to acc06edc's direct option. The abstract-object condition reaches 44000fce and 0bdb0436 jointly only under a domain choice no record makes. Countermodels are facts about interpretations. No earlier weighting is changed and no revision is declared; nothing is established or defeated.

current_assessment.supersedes: As the current-state summary for these nine statements only, it supersedes three wordings and no substantive judgment. First, the note's top paragraph 'Current proposed conclusion (2026-11-17)' as the summary for the seven statements it concerns (0bdb0436, 5854ef2b, 44000fce, 564ce19b, 251bbfdd, e8ffcdad, acc06edc); its conclusions are retained. Second, reading the 2026-11-11 heading's 'surviving rival' as evidence that 0bdb0436 is false; that section treated the rival as an undischarged alternative, and its non-discrimination judgment and next test are retained unchanged. Third, in e4879f4c's blocker, the listing of 44000fce among the 'Bare analyst premises' where read as its whole standing: the consolidated statement adds the recorded structural-to-grade burden and changes nothing. Nothing is displaced for 0bdb0436 or 5854ef2b. For 3c468121 nothing is displaced: e4879f4c's blocker lists the inputs of its two transcriptions, not its standing, and the 4381d190, c28c61d8 and c80cb2d6 findings and blockers are retained. For 30a8373c nothing is displaced: the 762d5fac and c80cb2d6 findings and blockers are retained. None of the nine statements had an earlier current_assessment; 3c468121 and 30a8373c had no earlier standing statement; 44000fce had scattered earlier records (2026-11-11 table and acceptance inventory, 2026-11-17 first-source section, e4879f4c blocker), all retained. Retained unchanged: the 1d6cfc76 summary and blocker, the 2026-11-09 bridge audit, the 2026-11-11 assessments, all 2026-11-17 sections with their reopening conditions and the q.11 allocation recommendation, the 2026-11-17 local-director assessment and the #1750 assessment of a1b799fe.
